source_coordinate_transform.order: scene node transform, then glTF Y-up to BIM Z-up, then operation yaw

selection_method: triangle centroid inside inclusive bounds in the yaw-rotated BIM frame
selection_caveat: A bounded centroid selection can hide intersecting or occluding surfaces; it is an observation filter, not evidence of enclosure truth.
evidence_caveat: Bounds and counts describe the supplied surface mesh only; they do not establish floors, rooms, enclosure, or a true footprint.

camera.top_view_fallback: When the view direction is parallel to Z, +Y is used as the stable up reference; otherwise BIM +Z is used.

pixel_center_mapping.formula: plane_xyz(row,col)=top_left+col*column_step+row*row_step; surface_xyz additionally advances along camera forward to the visible triangle
pixel_center_mapping.pixel_coordinates: zero-based [column, row] with image origin at top-left

rasterizer.texture_interpolation: barycentric UV, glTF REPEAT wrap, nearest texture pixel
rasterizer.texture_v_mapping: PIL image rows are the vertical inverse of glTF UV
rasterizer.depth_test: nearest positive distance along camera forward
rasterizer.material_display: unlit, double-sided geometric observation; sRGB base-color texture is decoded to linear RGB, multiplied by baseColorFactor, and encoded back to sRGB; this is not PBR-lighting or backface-culling faithful

artifacts.pixel_buffer_layout: sorted flat pixel indices with compact world XYZ and global face IDs
